name: Exterior Masonry Interstage Inspection
intent: Inspect coat 1 + touch-up. NO intercoat sanding — established exterior rule.
doctrine: Interstage. Inspect qt_scaled (QT3:1500, QT4:800). Touch-up qt_scaled (QT3:2000, QT4:1000). NO intercoat sanding per established exterior rule. Check mortar joints and pinholes.
